thread:
emily: Heads up — customer Borealis Labs' USD wire to 'Cascade Tech' just came back as RETURNED. Payment id pay_98765. Bank reason shows: "BIC_MISMATCH / Recipient bank not found for BIC ABCDUS33XXX". Anyone seen this pattern?

raj: Can you paste the wire instruction we sent? also the bank response blob.

emily: Sending wire instruction we received from customer:
```
Beneficiary: Cascade Tech
Account number: 123456789
IBAN: (empty, it's a US acct)
BIC/SWIFT: ABCDUS33XXX
Intermediary bank: CHASUS33 (provided by customer)
Currency: USD
```
API response snippet:
```
{
  "payment_id": "pay_98765",
  "status": "returned",
  "reason": "BIC_MISMATCH",
  "bank_response": "Recipient bank not found for BIC ABCDUS33XXX"
}
```

olivia: Quick check — that BIC looks non-standard. ABCDUS33XXX is 11 chars but the middle block 'US33' suggests Chase. Sometimes US wires require only an 8-char BIC (no branch XXX) or need an intermediary for routing. Also some correspondent chains reject when beneficiary tries to set an arbitrary intermediary. Did the customer supply both beneficiary bank and intermediary correctly?

mike: From infra side, our validation accepts 8 or 11 char BICs but we don't cross-check against a SWIFT/BIC list. We should fail-fast for clearly invalid formats. I'll open a quick ticket to add a stricter format and a warning in the console.

emily: Next steps I did: 1) opened bank escalation (carrier ticket #BANK-4521), 2) emailed Borealis for corrected SWIFT/intermediary, 3) initiated refund hold until we confirm. payments-bot created ticket BANK-4521.

payments-bot: automated: "Ticket BANK-4521 created with carrier. Assigned to ops-payments."

raj: For reproduction if needed: call the payments API to fetch the full settlement trace:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payments/pay_98765/trace
```
That returns the routing hops and bank error codes.

mike: Action items — (a) Support to confirm corrected BIC/intermediary from customer, (b) Ops to push escalation to carrier with full trace, (c) Eng to add validation task (#ENG-998) for SWIFT/BIC lookup + better error codes.

olivia: FYI, similar customer last month needed us to add intermediary "BOFAUS3N" for USD -> some smaller banks require Bank of America intermediary. We'll keep that note on the ticket.

emily: I'll update the support thread and close once carrier confirms. :thumbsup:
